name: champion-faculty
description: Sends a professor's newly created AI agent to their students. Paste the agent's share link and say which section, year and branch to send it to; it confirms the student count before sending over WhatsApp.

skills.name: Send an agent
skills.description: Publish a Gemini Enterprise agent to sections and send the link to those students over WhatsApp, after confirming how many people it reaches.
examples: Send an agent to my students

skills.name: Activation progress
skills.description: How much of the department has activated, section by section, and how the sections rank against each other.

skills.name: Ambassadors
skills.description: The department's student ambassadors, which sections have gone quiet, and which have no ambassador at all.

skills.name: My agents
skills.description: The professor's published agents and how much students actually use them.
